knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the owner buys the managed outcome, with certainty. Your hourly rate, your office or your years in business are not what the offer sells.

The lesson says a guarantee must be something you control and can afford, such as response times and report accuracy. Guarantees covering tenants' rent or any vacancy with a refund are not what the lesson supports.

The lesson says the fee basis is stated in the appointment, with the services included, the exclusions and any commission in writing. A single figure with no scope or a vague promise does not meet that.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
